tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List public channels in the workspace with their ids. Use this when you need a channel id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.title: Post message
tools.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel. Each call posts another message; a retry posts a duplicate.

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel to post to

tools.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tools.title: Reply to thread
tools.description: Reply to a specific message thread. Each call posts another reply; a retry posts a duplicate.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message, for example 1234567890.123456

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.title: Get channel history
tools.description: Get recent messages from a channel. Use this when the user asks what was said in a channel.

tools.name: slack_summarize_for_user
tools.title: Summarize for user
tools.description: Summarizes the discussion so far and posts it to a channel. Pass the whole conversation so the summary is complete.

channel_id.description: Channel to post the summary to

conversation_history.description: All messages exchanged with the assistant so far

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.title: Add reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. Adding the same reaction twice has no further effect, so it is safe to retry.

reaction.description: Emoji name without colons, for example thumbsup
